name: DomainNet
description: Large-scale domain adaptation benchmark comprising images from six visual domains: clipart, infograph, painting, quickdraw, real, and sketch, organized into 345 object categories.
citation: Peng, X., Usman, B., Kaushik, N., Hoffman, J., Wang, D., & Saenko, K. (2019). Moment Matching for Multi-Source Domain Adaptation. IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV). https://doi.org/10.1109/ICCV.2019.00515
